summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend validation of the new Reviews feature plus quick re-verification of Properties search/pagination and Sell form. Backend: 31/31 pytest cases pass, including 9 new review-focused tests (create, rating 1-5 validation, moderation hiding, admin approve/reply/delete flow, per-agent summary, office target forces agent_id null, auth guards, cleanup). Frontend E2E via Playwright confirmed: public /recenze form submits office + agent-targeted reviews with Czech success toast 'Děkujeme! Recenze byla odeslána ke schválení.'; pending review NOT shown on public list; admin login → Recenze tab shows pending badge and approve/reply/delete buttons work; after approval the review appears on /recenze with correct target label ('Kancelář RE/MAX Active Broker' vs 'Makléř: <name>'), stars, deal type and admin reply block ('Odpověď RE/MAX Active Broker'); Team page (/tym) shows agent-rating-{id} summary (5.0, 1) after agent review approved; homepage renders home-review-* testimonials (2 cards); admin delete removes card with 'Smazáno' toast; overview stats show 'Recenze' and 'Recenze ke schválení' labels; Sell form (/prodej) → /api/contact 200 with subject 'Poptávka: Prodej nemovitosti' badge visible in admin Messages (verified via both existing 'Test Prodej' entry and direct curl); Properties search filters (search-location/price-min/price-max) narrow counts (73→11→8), search-reset restores, pagination page-2/page-next/page-prev all present and clickable.
critical_code_review_comments: ReviewCreate does not restrict target_type / deal_type to an enum — a client can send arbitrary strings and they will be stored (e.g., target_type='foo'). Consider Literal['office','agent'] and Literal for deal_type to harden the API.
GET /api/reviews (public) does not paginate; capped at .to_list(500). Fine for now but plan pagination as reviews grow.

Pydantic EmailStr on /api/contact rejects reserved TLDs like '.test' (returns 422). The Sell.jsx form treats any thrown error as a generic failure — that is correct, but you may want a clearer error toast when 422 fields come back so users understand the email issue.

Reviews.jsx renders raw r.text via

...

which is safe (React escapes), but user-entered content is not length-capped server-side — consider max_length on ReviewCreate.text (e.g., 2000 chars).
reviews_summary aggregation groups only target_type='agent' — office reviews are excluded from any summary; if you later want an office-wide avg, add a second aggregate or expose via /api/stats.

Agent-count assertion updated from >=5 to >=4 in tests because the seed / DB currently contains 4 agents (matches homepage copy 'čtyři zkušené makléře'). Iteration_1 expected 5; confirm this reduction is intentional.
seed_data_creation: During testing I created 2 E2E reviews (office + agent-targeted) — both approved, replied, then deleted. Ran automated cleanup that also purges any TEST_/E2E prefixed reviews. Reviews collection is empty again after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py now has 31 cases including full Reviews CRUD + moderation flow. Frontend Reviews testids verified working: reviews-page, review-form, star-1..star-5, review-target, review-agent, review-deal, review-name, review-email, review-text, review-submit-btn, reviews-empty, review-{id}. Admin: admin-tab-reviews, admin-reviews-panel, reviews-filter-{pending|approved|all}, admin-review-{id}, approve-review-{id}, reply-review-{id}, reply-text-{id}, reply-save-{id}, delete-review-{id}. Team page: agent-rating-{agentId}. Home: home-review-{id}. Note: Sell form /prodej email validation rejects '.test' TLD (pydantic EmailStr) — use example.com in future tests.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in the new Reviews feature. All acceptance criteria from the review-request are satisfied.
